preview.tournamentOverview: The Cliffs at Walnut Cove is a mountain course that rewards ball-striking and approach play over raw distance. SG APP (20%) and SG Total (30%) dominate the model, while SG PUTT (15%) and SG OTT (15%) round out the key inputs. This Korn Ferry Tour event serves as a critical springboard for players seeking PGA Tour promotion.
preview.modelExplainer: SG Total carries the heaviest weight at 30%, followed by SG APP at 20% and SG OTT at 15%, reflecting the course's emphasis on iron play and off-the-tee accuracy. The model prioritizes consistent ball-strikers who limit mistakes on a layout that punishes errant approaches.
preview.pickApproach: Top-tier bets target players with strong SG APP and SG Total marks who also rank inside the top 30 in power rankings. Mid-tier wagers focus on golfers with positive SG Total but weaker power rankings, betting on course fit to elevate their performance. Long-shot plays look for SG Putt or SG ATG outliers who can capitalize on the 15% and 10% weights despite lower overall rankings.
